$comment: KEYSTONE REGISTRY. Single source of truth for brand identity. Edit this, then run build.py. Never hand-edit files under exports/.
$tagline_policy: Taglines are DEFINED here as reference, used sparingly and NEVER on the lockup. Generated artifacts (email signature, letterhead, guidelines cover, deck) do not print them by default. Per brand: tagline_en and/or tagline_tr (either, both, or neither).

type.$source: Matched to the LIVE site agustos.com (verified 2026-06-20): weight 650, letter-spacing normal. DESIGN.md, BrandLockup.astro, and the Rails adapter were reconciled to 650 on 2026-06-20 (they previously said Light 300). tokens.css weight 300 is .type-hero, NOT the lockup — left unchanged.

signal.$source: Ağustos red is the shared interaction signal across every house brand. It recolors a non-Ağustos identity mark only on hover (v7.0.0).

$clients_policy: Client brands are brands Ağustos builds for. Each registers its own logo, colours and fonts, and keeps them; the house rules on the Laz Güneşi, red and black buttons do not apply. Light theme only. The build writes ui/brands/<slug>.css and ui/brands/<slug>.svg. A page loads agustos-fonts.css, agustos.css, then ui/brands/<slug>.css, and puts brand-<slug> on <body>. Unset colours keep the kit value.

heper.title: HEPER
heper.$source: Logo: IESDesk public/heper/heper-logo.svg. Colours and font: WEBSITE-heper-dashboard DESIGN.md and rails_app/public/static/styles.css. Buttons stay ink because HEPER uses red on purpose, not everywhere.

ligman.title: LIGMAN
ligman.$source: Logo: traced from APP-ligmanone public/logo.png; replace it with the official vector file when LIGMAN sends one. Colours and fonts: APP-ligmanone DESIGN.md. Yellow on white is 1.5:1, so focus rings and hover text take the dark grey.
